Name: DefiningConceptReference
Description: A concept that defines or aids in understanding the content of the population. For example the Population "Males" may link to the concept of "Male".

Name: UniverseReference
Description: Reference to the Universe that describes the core of this Population.These may be constrained by specifications within the Variable description. TypeOfObject should be set to Universe.

Name: UnitTypeReference
Description: Reference to a unit type being associated with this Population. TypeOfObject should be set to UnitType.

Name: TypeOfUnit
Description: The entity type associated with this Population. For example, individuals, families or households, groups, institutions/organizations, administrative units, etc. Supports the use of an external controlled vocabulary.

Name: GeographyOfPopulation
Description: Description of the geographic coverage of the population.

Name: TimePeriodOfPopulation
Description: Reference to specific time period for the Population. Repeat for non-continuous time periods.

Name: IsInclusive
Description: The default value is true. The description statement of a Population is generally stated in inclusive terms such as All persons residing in Europe. Occasionally a Population is defined by what it excludes, i.e., All persons residing in Europe except for those residing on U.S. Military bases. In this case the value would be changed to false.
